raw_utilization_delta.meaning: rawUtilizationDelta = userUtilizationAfter - userUtilizationBefore for the new passive user's first epoch

prior_epoch_eligible_rewards.meaning: _userEligibleRewardsForEpoch(_account, _epoch - 1), rewards claimable in the prior epoch

first_claim_yield_ratio.meaning: utilization ratio applied to the new passive user's first-claim yield, reported slashed to personalUtilizationLowerBound default 2500 (25%)

basis_points_divisor.meaning: BASIS_POINTS_DIVISOR, the full (unpenalized) utilization ratio the exempt first claim should receive

passive_stake_no_multivault.meaning: new user stakes TRUST purely for yield and does not interact with the MultiVault

first_claim_attempted.meaning: the new passive user attempts to make their first claim

assumptions: The first-claim exemption applies when the user had nothing claimable in the prior epoch, i.e. _userEligibleRewardsForEpoch(_account, _epoch - 1) == 0.
The new passive user's first claim is a legitimate own-account claim; no unauthorized-caller condition is involved.

unresolved.description: Report does not state whether the first-claim exemption's _userEligibleRewardsForEpoch(_account, _epoch - 1) == 0 condition holds for the described passive user; only the userUtilizationTarget == 0 branch is discussed.
The 75% destroyed-yield figure is derived from the 25% lower bound; report gives no explicit numeric expected-versus-actual yield values.

limitations: The impact magnitude is retained as the reported personalUtilizationLowerBound default 2500 basis points (25%); the exact expected full yield amount is not numerically stated.
The 75% destroyed-yield consequence is a separate impact handled in a different claim-generation pass and is not formalized here.
The exemption's prior-epoch eligibility condition is treated as an assumption because the report only discusses the userUtilizationTarget == 0 branch.
